name: event-os
description: Event OS - Microservices Backend for Event Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@event-os/types && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/config
scripts.build:services: npm run build --workspace=@event-os/api-gateway && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/auth-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/event-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/team-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/ticket-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/checkin-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/announcement-service && npm run build --workspace=@event-os/notification-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:services
scripts.typecheck:services: tsc --noEmit -p packages/types && tsc --noEmit -p packages/config && tsc --noEmit -p services/api-gateway && tsc --noEmit -p services/auth-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/event-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/team-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/ticket-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/checkin-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/announcement-service && tsc --noEmit -p services/notification-service
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:services && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,EVENT,TEAM,TICKET,CHECKIN,ANNOUNCE,NOTIFY" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red,white,gray" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/api-gateway" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/auth-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/event-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/team-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/ticket-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/checkin-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/announcement-service" "npm run dev --workspace=@event-os/notification-service"

author: Event OS Team
